description: SpongeAura is a minecraft mod for 26.3 that automates draining rivers, water caves, aquifers, and stray pockets without wasting sponges on self-refilling ocean holes, and auto-dries wet sponges in the Nether. You only need the last file: spongeaura-2.2.2.jar - put it in your mods folder and your good to go. :)

mods.name: SpongeAura
mods.description: Smart source-only perimeter sponge automation with anti-refill physics, tiny-source junk-block filling, horizontal X/Z work area bounds, two efficiency modes, manual placement takeover, Nether auto-drying, auto-refill, safe wet-sponge breaking, and through-wall sponge highlighting.
